name: SDCG
recent: SDCG 在 2026 年 10 月出现董事 Edison Kong 的股权转移公告，涉及 600 万股普通股在个人账户与质押账户之间的转移，实益所有权不变。公司于 9 月底有两名主要管理人员变动，8 月则发布了 2026 财年第二季度业绩。
notable: 董事 Edison Kong 于 2026 年 10 月 15 日转移 600 万股普通股，实益所有权不变。
公司于 2026 年 9 月 30 日公告两名主要管理人员变动：CIK WAN RATIMA AKMAR BINTI WAN SAUDI 与 MISS GAN YEE SHAN。
公司于 2026 年 8 月 21 日发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。
risks: 董事 Edison Kong 在 2026 年 8 月 18 日于闭市期间转移 2100 万股普通股，实益所有权不变。
公司于 2026 年 9 月 30 日公告两名主要管理人员变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 10,625,000 令吉，净利润为 698,000 令吉，净利率 6.6%。营收环比增长 47.2%，同比增长 115.4%；净利润同比增长 67.0%，上一季度净利率为 -6.7%。

recent_en: In October 2026, SDCG disclosed a transfer of 6 million ordinary shares by Director Edison Kong between his personal account and a pledged securities account, with no change in beneficial ownership. The company saw two principal officer changes in late September and released its 2Q 2026 results in August.
notable_en: Director Edison Kong transferred 6 million ordinary shares on 15 Oct 2026, with no change in beneficial ownership.
The company announced changes in two principal officers, CIK WAN RATIMA AKMAR BINTI WAN SAUDI and MISS GAN YEE SHAN, on 30 Sep 2026.
The company released its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 30 Jun 2026 on 21 Aug 2026.
risks_en: Director Edison Kong transferred 21 million ordinary shares during the closed period on 18 Aug 2026, with no change in beneficial ownership.
The company announced changes in two principal officers on 30 Sep 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was MYR 10,625,000 and net income was MYR 698,000, with a net margin of 6.6%. Revenue grew 47.2% QoQ and 115.4% YoY; net income rose 67.0% YoY, while the previous quarter's net margin was -6.7%.
